title: Self-Pay Visit Package and Plan-of-Care Funding in the Missed First Appointment Basis
content:
Revenue Cycle memo — how the funding of an Appointment Series sets the first-appointment no-show basis.

**Rule.** The first-appointment no-show basis follows the funding of the series: where the series is funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package whose package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero, the basis is 50 percent of that single-visit cash rate; where the series is funded by an Insured Plan of Care whose verified copay is above zero, the basis is the lesser of the no-show fee of the series' format and that copay; for any other series the basis is the no-show fee of the series' format.

**Records read.** The funding source on the series record; the single-visit cash rate listed for the tier of the funding Self-Pay Visit Package; the verified copay on the funding Insured Plan of Care.

**Worked cases (hypothetical figures; format no-show fee USD 50.00).**

1. Self-Pay Visit Package whose tier lists a cash rate of USD 125.00: 50 percent of USD 125.00 gives a basis of USD 62.50.
2. Insured Plan of Care with a verified copay of USD 20.00: the lesser of USD 50.00 and USD 20.00 is USD 20.00.
3. Insured Plan of Care with a verified copay of USD 0.00: the basis is the format no-show fee, USD 50.00.
4. Wellness Membership or Workers' Compensation Referral: the basis is USD 50.00.
